The analysis is clear. Two resources drive the cost increase on 2025-10-20 for account `xz8lX1K`:

1. **GCP cloud service `zjTD5`** (application 6IN, instance family QI78eHTqNo): num_instances jumped from ~2 on 10/19 to 50 on 10/20 (cost $63.70 → $1,592.40), contributing ~+$1,016 vs baseline.
2. **AWS cloud service `3wTal`** (application sDS, instance family W4ugKNiEYE): unit price jumped from $0.45 to $1.50 exactly on 10/20 with 18 instances (cost $194.40 → $648.00), contributing ~+$239 vs baseline — a commitment (10/20/24–10/19/25) expired and pricing changed.

No other resource shows a meaningful deviation on that date (next largest is ~$10, i.e. noise).
